```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, messages=FALSE, purl=F}
library(knitr)
library(ramp.xds)
library(deSolve)
library(ramp.library)
```


In **`ramp.xds`** and **`ramp.library`** there are several modules that would be considered suitable for modeling some aspects of malaria epidemiology.

Except for `hMoI`, all XH modules support observed prevalence through
`F_pr_obs`, using test positivity `q` (default `0.8`) times true prevalence.
Set `q` through `XHoptions` at setup or `change_XH_pars` afterward;
retrieve the output with `get_PR(model, method = "obs")` after solving.
The existing diagnostic-specific parameters and methods in library modules
are unchanged.

+ **`ramp.xds`**

  +  `hMoI`
  
  +  `SIS`

+ **`ramp.library`**
  
  +  `SIP`
  
  +  `SIPd`
  
  +  `SEIS`
  
  +  `SEISd`
  
  +  `garki`
